title: "Beef" actor David Choe's rape comments resurface
summary: A roughly three-minute 2023 edited news/commentary package combining a graphic archival podcast excerpt, reporter paraphrase of the massage story, a time-bound report about clip circulation/copyright claims and non-response, Choe’s reported 2014 denial, and a commentator’s accountability argument. The record preserves all sexual-assault language, the denial, DMCA allegation and Weinstein comparison while preventing direct speech, reporting, quotation, allegation and opinion from collapsing into one evidentiary voice. No private identity, criminal finding, cast knowledge, illegal-takedown conclusion or line-level speaker is invented.
